{{Quote|Intergalactic nerf-throwing champion who mortally injured several nerfs.|Jabrogg Thung's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Jabrogg Thung''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Thung had become an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[nerf-throwing]] champion who had mortally injured several [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]]<ref name="Prima" />&mdash;an [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GAS" /> As a result, the [[Galactic Humane Society]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head, offering 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his capture or 1,000 upon [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Prima" /> Thung eventually joined a group of thugs led by the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]]. The Gamorrean wore a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], shoulder [[Armor/Legends|armor]], two [[Vambrace/Legends|vambraces]], [[Limb|foot]] wraps, and brown [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with straps across his torso.<ref name="BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While hunting for Ghintee on Outland Station<ref name="BH" /> in 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango fett]] was ambushed by Thung and two other Gammorreans wielding [[Gamorrean war ax/Legends|war axes]] upon entering<ref name="BH" /> a training area.<ref name="Prima" /> Fett dispatched Thung's companions and captured him alive for the full sum of [[Currency/Legends|credits]].<ref name="BH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jabrogg Thung first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Thung is the second optional bounty available to the player that can be captured alive for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that Jango Fett captured Thung alive for the full sum of credits.
